appearance.extreme: They have two fully developed heads. Both are alert. Both are watching you, and they aren't watching the same thing.
appearance.obvious: A second head sits on their left shoulder, small and malformed, and its eyes are open.
appearance.subtle: There's a swelling at the base of their neck that's the wrong shape.

description: A second head has grown from your shoulder. It sleeps when you sleep. It doesn't always look where you look.
drawbacks: No helmet made for one head fits two
name: Second Head
